card.name: The word end in "To that end"
card.fires_on: The word "end" (or "purpose") in the phrase "To that end" / "To this end" at the start of a sentence, after a stated goal. Weaker on a few other linking words such as "for which".

modes.label: To that/this end
modes.description: "End" completes a sentence-opening phrase that links back to a goal just stated.
modes.example: They hope to better understand the condition and discover an effective treatment. To that<< end>>, hemochromatosis research studies

modes.label: For that purpose
modes.description: A similar goal-linking noun or phrase, such as "purpose" or "for which".
modes.example: For that<< purpose>> the following Dose Conversion Table is provided
